cohort: Reuse the label-free stage probe's three filename-hash-selected QfO species and 32 gene-ID-hash-selected queries per cyclic species pair, retaining original query order and each complete target proteome.
order: Warm all three arms, then measure all six permutations of their ordering on identical arrays. Original division loads the existing frozen live-search library; the other two arms share one newly compiled library and identical compiler flags.
purpose: Control for changes in default-path cost caused by the opt-in refactor, rather than assuming recurrence versus refactored division implies improvement versus the actual original kernel.
limitations: Shared-host short kernel measurements remain noisy, and the original frozen library may have different historical compilation provenance. No truth labels, new orthology scores, default promotion, or full-pipeline speed claims.
